title: Normal-Anchored First-Order Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning based Whisper Fine-Tuning for Enhancing Fairness of Cleft Lip and Palate Speech Recognition

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating a Fairness Score (FS) based on the Word Error Rate (WER) disparity between speakers with typical/normal speech and speakers with Cleft Lip and Palate (CLP) speech disorders across various severity levels.
